items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: A very famous drummer, he and I became very good friends over the years, Ed Shaughnessy.

ctx.x: A very famous drummer, he and I became very good friends over the years, Ed Shaughnessy. And he took lessons with the same guy. And we were sort of like, as we got older, friendly rivals. And I went in the service and Ed was too young. And when I came out he was still there. And so we took up our friendship again. And we were helpful to each other in our careers. And I recommended him for jobs and he recommended me. Because you can’t do anything alone in this business. You’ve got to have help. I had a lot of help…
